definitions.explanation: A person who lives nearby, especially in an adjacent house or apartment.

examples.japanese: {隣人|りんじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仲|なか}が{良|よ}い→仲が良い：20668_nakagayoi⟧。
examples.english: I get along well with my neighbors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{隣人|りんじん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A noise complaint came from a neighbor.

examples.japanese: {隣人|りんじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I value my relationship with my neighbors.

notes:
{隣人|りんじん} is a more formal word for neighbor.

FORMS:
{隣|りん} (next to, adjacent) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {隣人|りんじん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: neighbor relations
- {隣人|りんじん}{愛|あい}: love for one's neighbor (often religious context)
- {隣人|りんじん}⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧: neighbor trouble/disputes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: the person next door (casual)
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: neighborhood people
- ご⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧さん: neighbors (friendly, casual)

USAGE:
{隣人|りんじん} is more literary/formal compared to ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.
